name: arcade-basic-codemirror
description: Builds wwwroot/lib/codemirror.js, the one-file CodeMirror 6 bundle the playground's editor imports. The bundle is committed, so publishing the playground needs no npm; run `npm ci && npm run build` here after changing entry.js or the versions.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=../wwwroot/lib/codemirror.js --banner:js="/* CodeMirror 6 (https://codemirror.net), MIT licence: see codemirror.LICENSE.txt. Built from src/ArcadeBasic.Web/codemirror. */" && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/@codemirror/view/LICENSE', '../wwwroot/lib/codemirror.LICENSE.txt')"
